shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive). ## Workflow rule (global) Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\\\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules live in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md`. Key engineering rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code** and **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score per fix. ## AUDIT + REMEDIATION STATUS Full report: `Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md` (+ .pdf, 12pp). Regenerate PDF: `python Docs/_mkpdf.py Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.html` then Edge `--headless=new --print-to-pdf` (needs Windows paths + a `file:///` URL). ### TRANCHE A - DONE, builds clean, 4 passovers passed. NOT YET TESTED IN-GAME. Backup: `D:\Rimworld\RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment\20260731-133346\`. - **C1 (97%) FIXED** - new `SoftDeps.ModActive(packageId)` helper; ALL soft-dep probes route through it. `ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier` exact-matches, but Steam mods carry `ModMetaData.SteamModPostfix` = `"_steam"`, so 6 of 11 probes were silently false on this machine (FacialAnim, SpeakUp, RimTalk, SimpleSlaveryCollars, BondageBed, Rimpsyche-Sexuality). **Those bridges have effectively never executed here - first test run is the real smoke test.** FreeWillBridge routed through the helper too. RULE: never call `GetActiveModWithIdentifier` directly for a soft dep. - **U10 (99%) FIXED** - deleted `Patch_HaremResizeGrip` (a postfix on `Verse.Window.WindowOnGUI`, which the game calls for EVERY window on EVERY IMGUI event). `Window_Harem` now overrides `WindowOnGUI` itself: `base.WindowOnGUI()` then draw. Coordinates there are SCREEN space (post-`GUI.Window`, outside the group) - identical to the old postfix. RULE: never patch a global UI method for our own window chrome. - **T1 (98%) FIXED** - new `MapComponent_HarassmentScan.Due(now, interval, phase)` + a stable per-map `_mapPhase` (`abs(map.uniqueID*37)%1000`). Every periodic system now carries a distinct phase, so the four heavy 2500-cadence passes (ControlUpkeep breakout / ConditioningUpkeep 811 / RecomputeHeadGirls 1607 / GameComponent profile sweep 2213) no longer stack on one tick. Also phased: PhotoScavenge 275 (never coincides with EvilKeyScavenge now), HeadGirlTick 431, MemoryReactionScan 149, beg 67, affection 233; GameComponent notoriety 12007 / world-incidents 41011 / RescueRaidTick 137. **GOTCHA:** the nested onahole `now % 600` check MUST also go through `Due(now, 600, 0)` - 600 is a multiple of followTick's 60 and shares `_mapPhase`, so alignment holds; a raw `% 600` would be permanently out of phase and never fire. - **C2 (94%) FIXED** - `_onaholeBedTypeTried` / `_beOnaholeTypeTried` sentinels. `if (_t == null) _t = GetTypeInAnyAssembly(...)` treats "absent" as "not looked up", re-scanning every assembly on every call - and both sit under `IsInOnaholeBed`. (`_rmbTried`/`_rmbBestTried`/`_coffeeTried` already had this.) - **T4 (99%) FIXED** - `RecomputeHeadGirls` uses static scratch `_hgBestScore/_hgBestPet/_hgTracked`, cleared on entry **and on exit** (the exit clear matters: static scratch holding `Pawn` refs would pin a dead Game graph across save/load). ### REMAINING - approved-for-analysis, NOT built - **Tranche B - VRAM & frame time (~85 ln):** U1 (95%) quantise the resize-derived stage-doll size before `PortraitsCache.Get` (RimWorld pools expired portrait RenderTextures and never destroys them outside `PortraitsCache.Clear()`; a resize drag strands ~225-450 MB for the session). U5 (99%) scroll-rect culling - there is none, and Harem rows are 200 px tall. U2 (93%) animate the destination Rect, not `cameraZoom` (44 live RTs, ~66 MB spike per Stylist open). U4 (90%) Repaint-gate portraits + decorative draws. U3 (97%) collapse 8 headshot sizes to 2. **Open questions: 16 px vs 8 px quantisation; rect-animation vs 1/8 zoom quantisation.** - **Tranche C - shared UI framework (~250 ln):** F1 (99%) promote GrayButton/GrayToggle/IconButton/MiniHeader/FillBar/Portrait/Card into `ModernStyle` - currently duplicated across Window_Harem, Dialog_DressUp, Dialog_Stylist, SexualityPanelDrawer, which is what let 8 portrait sizes proliferate. U8 (98%) frame-stamp the roster/filter/summary caches (`AllPets()`+`FilterSortPets()` rebuild per IMGUI event: cross-map scan, 5 list allocs, `ToLowerInvariant()` per pawn, `List.Contains` O(n^2)). U6 (96%) `FillBar` on `WhiteTex`+`GUI.color` (per-colour 2x2 textures break IMGUI batching). U11 (96%) frame-cache the gizmo list. U7 (97%) Repaint-gate + cache border-icon rects. - **Tranche D - tick hygiene + compat depth:** T2 (99%) route the 5 interval scans (RecomputeHeadGirls, HeadGirlTick, MemoryReactionScan, EvilKeyScavenge, PhotoScavenge) through the existing `_humanlikes`/`_profiled` index instead of raw `AllPawnsSpawned`. C3 (90%) re-key `FindLockedVictimForKey` statics to int ids (they hold a live `CompHoloCryptoStamped` + `Pawn` -> roots a dead Game graph). T3 (92%) cap + reorder `MemoryReactionScan`'s `LineOfSight`. F2 (95%) TickScheduler. T5 (93%, **data risk**) prune `GameComponent.profiles` - never pruned, deep-Scribed into every save. F3 continue the partial-class split of the 6577-line HarassmentEngine.cs. - **Unexploited ACTIVE integrations** (catalogued in the doc): Vanilla Skills Expanded ExpertiseDefs (Phase E flagship, confirmed installed), **check-first risk pair** `Mlie.Suppression` (overlaps SlaveryHooks.SyncSuppression) + `Mlie.PrisonersDontHaveKeys` (overlaps Holokey inventory logic), then Nudity Matters More, Privacy Please, RimHUD, Grudges!, Rimpsyche-Disposition, Restraints/SimpleRestraintBelt, Epitaph/In Memoriam, VSIE, MorePrecepts/AlphaMemes. Melee Animation is claimed as a soft dep but has NO implementing code - wire it or drop the claim. - **Premise correction recorded in the audit:** IMGUI is not the VRAM consumer - `PortraitsCache` RenderTextures are. IMGUI's cost here is draw calls + CPU. UIToolkit is NOT viable in 1.6 (cannot interleave with `Verse.WindowStack`); `Widgets.DrawAtlas` would be a regression (9 draws vs our 5). ## Facial Animation integration (FacialAnimation/Defs/FaceAnims_Harassment.xml) - loads IfModActive Nals.FacialAnimation Two classes of FaceAnimationDef: - **PERSISTENT (thought-gated):** RJWSH_FA_Nervous/_Afraid/_Hollow/_Devoted. No targetJobs (defaults to ConstantJob = ambient), but gated by `targetThoughtDefs` (+ mood range on _Hollow), so FA only shows them while the pawn carries the matching moodlet. Same pattern as FA's own Thought_Naked. - **ONE-SHOT (played from C# via FABridge.PlayTemporaryAnimation):** RJWSH_FA_Flinch/_Cry/_Bliss, priority 400. **GOTCHA (fixed):** FaceAnimationDef's ctor defaults targetJobs to ["ConstantJob"], and FA applies any ConstantJob def that has NO targetThoughtDefs to EVERY pawn every tick - so these one-shots were pinning every FA colonist's face into a permanent flinch/cry/bliss. Fix = sentinel `
  • RJWSH_NeverAmbient
    • ` - removes them from all ambient lists while PlayTemporaryAnimation still works. FABridge.PlayFace also plays FA's own job-gated "Strip" face during the strip driver. ## Performance framework (PawnIndex.cs) - **Per-tick pawn index (on MapComponent_HarassmentScan):** `EnsureIndex()` rebuilds at most once per game tick (stamp = TicksGame) a `Dictionary _byId` + snapshots `_humanlikes` / `_profiled`. `PawnById(id)` is O(1). Killed the old O(n^2) control upkeep. Upkeep loops iterate `_profiled` (ControlUpkeep, BegUpkeep) or `_humanlikes` (ConditioningUpkeep, AffectionUpkeep). **Gap (T2, still open): the five interval scans bypass it.** - **PawnLookup (static):** `OnMap(map,id)` / `AnyMap(id)` route through each map's index. - **PawnFlagCache (static, tick-scoped memo):** memoizes `WearingControlCollar` / `WearingSlaveryCollar` / `IsInOnaholeBed`. Keys are pawn ids (never Pawn refs -> no dead-Game-graph leak); clears on tick turnover; collar equip/remove sites call `Invalidate`. Self-healing. - **Tick phasing:** `Due(now, interval, phase)` + per-map `_mapPhase` (see Tranche A above). ## Performance settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) - conservative defaults **enableDepthSystems** (ON) - master toggle for the heaviest per-pet layer; core break-in + visible hediffs still run when OFF. **enableAmbientBanter** (ON) + **ambientBanterScale** (0.6). **affectionInterval** (3000), **begInterval** (450); 0 disables either. ## EXPANSION ROADMAP (user-approved 10-idea list, phases A-E) A (DONE) #7 notoriety/Karma + #1 Tales. B (DONE) #2 chronicle + #3 owner death/legacy. C (DONE) #4 nemesis + #6 blackmail. D (DONE) #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training. **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs (Bodyguard=Melee, Handler=Social, Courtesan=Sex-skill w/ Sexperience, hediff fallback without VSE) + #9 Hospitality integration. Audit confirms `vanillaexpanded.skills` is installed and active. ## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs) `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public):** absolute opposite-sex override (enforceOppositeSex/heterosexualOnly), downed-hostile opportunism ignores orientation, else RJW discrete orientation. **Approach re-validates sex:** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` during the walk (FailOn) AND at arrival. Player-directed grope/force bypasses the re-check. ## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs) `interactiveTraining` (default ON): the Command deck **Discipline** button opens a read-the-pet minigame. 3 rounds; hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. Correct match deepens conditioning + lowers subDom; misread piles trauma. ## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8) Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**: collaring ceremony + devotion parade. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.** ## Tales / Chronicle / Owner death / Nemesis / Blackmail Tales: `TaleHelper.Record` null-guarded; 6 TaleDefs at milestones. Chronicle: `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100), History tab. Owner death: Harmony Postfix on Pawn.Kill -> OnOwnerDied (grief/hypnosis-shed/heir). Nemesis: escaped/sold pets return as raid leaders (MTB by grudge). Blackmail: photo gizmo -> faction demand; pay/refuse branches; notoriety. Shared helpers: `SpawnAssaultRaid` / `PickRaidFaction`. ## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs) `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. World-incident pacing scales with colony regard. No-ops without Karma. ## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" FLOATING Window (Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Left roster + center STAGE / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands, Schedule, Context tabs Feed/Graph/History/[Profile]/Social) + COLONY OPS. Now owns its resize grip via a `WindowOnGUI` override. **2761 lines; Tranche B/C findings all live here.** ## Pet market / Conditioning / Break stages GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility). BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis. **`GameComponent.profiles` still has no pruning path (T5).** ## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (default OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, **Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval**, etc. ## Conventions Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction/sex gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted (public).** **Perf: id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById; hot apparel/bed predicates via PawnFlagCache; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **FA: any one-shot FaceAnimationDef MUST carry a sentinel targetJobs.** **Soft-dep probes go through `SoftDeps.ModActive` (Steam `_steam` suffix).** **Periodic work goes through `Due(now, interval, phase)` - never a bare `now % N`.** **Never pass an unquantised, resize-derived size to `PortraitsCache.Get`.** **Never Harmony-patch a global UI method for our own window chrome.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
